# Fire Under Ice website Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build and publish a one-page static website for Fire Under Ice at `https://fireunderice.org`, generated by Python from `content.yaml`, deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

**Architecture:** `content.yaml` holds all text. `build.py` loads it, validates it, drops non-consented people/partners, and renders Jinja2 templates into `_site/index.html`, copying `static/` alongside. `prepare_images.py` turns brochure originals into committed WebP files. A GitHub Actions workflow runs `uv run build.py` and publishes `_site/`.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12+ via uv; jinja2, pyyaml, pillow; pytest (dev); plain CSS and JS (no libraries); Cabin font (woff2, self-hosted); GitHub Actions + GitHub Pages; Cloudflare Registrar, DNS and Email Routing.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-fire-under-ice-site-design.md` (read it first). Original requirements: `~/expeditions/Iceland/brochure/2027/website_spec.md`.

**Teaching rule for this project:** Lorenzo has never built a website and wants to learn. After each task, give him a short "what just happened and why" (3-6 lines). Tasks marked **[Lorenzo]** are done by him, guided step by step; never perform account, payment or DNS actions on his behalf.

## Global Constraints

- Repo root: `~/expeditions/Iceland/website/`. `BROCHURE` = `~/expeditions/Iceland/brochure/2027/`. Never modify `BROCHURE` except in Task 12.
- All Python runs through uv: `uv run ...`, deps in `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock` committed.
- Dependencies: `jinja2`, `pyyaml`, `pillow` (main); `pytest` (dev group). No other packages, no JS libraries, no CSS frameworks.
- All URLs in generated HTML are relative (`static/...`); no `src="/` or `href="/` anywhere.
- No third-party requests on page load. YouTube only after a click, via `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/913rFrz9-xo`.
- Colours: `--bg #0D0D0D`, `--ice #00C2FF`, `--magma #FF4500`, `--text #FFFFFF`; text contrast at least 4.5:1.
- Copy: English, dry, no emoji, no superlatives, never invent values. Spelling: Kverkfjöll, Dyngjujökull, Torfajökull, Mýrdalsjökull, Grímsvötn, Vatnajökull, Hveradalur, Kaldaklofsjökull, Galtarlón. The 1980s-2008 Kverkfjöll exploration was Swiss.
- Forbidden phrases (build error, case-insensitive): "heart of Europe", "2000 MW", "Kinetic Trigger", "extremophile".
- Credits: "Original artwork by Lee Florea"; surveys by Cristian Monticone; basemap "Landmælingar Íslands, IS 50V, CC BY 4.0".
- Contact: `info@fireunderice.org` only. No phone numbers, no personal emails.
- CSI logo: hero/team and footer only, never in the partners row.
- Never commit originals: `.gitignore` blocks `_site/`, `.venv/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.jpg`, `*.JPG`, `*.jpeg`, `*.tif*`, `*.raw`, `*.cr2`, `*.nef`, `*.dng`, `*.mp4`, `*.mov`, `*.pdf`.
- Commit messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

## Review Focus

1. **Icelandic/Italian characters** (ö, ý, Í, æ, à) must render correctly: output written as UTF-8 with `<meta charset="utf-8">`. Test in Task 3.
2. **Subpath hosting**: the site must work at `lorbordin.github.io/fire-under-ice-site/` before the domain exists; any root-absolute URL breaks it. Test in Task 3.
3. **Consent fail-safe**: an entry with the `consent` key missing or misspelled must be hidden, not shown. Test in Task 2.
4. **HTML injection from YAML**: a `<` or `&` in copy (e.g. "R&D") must be escaped, and only `*italic*` becomes markup. Test in Task 2.
5. **Stale output**: a file removed from `static/` must not survive in `_site/` from a previous build. Test in Task 3.

### Task 2: `sitelib.py` (load, validate, consent, italics, images)

**Files:** Create `sitelib.py`, `tests/test_sitelib.py`.

**Interfaces (Produces):**
- `load_content(path: Path) -> dict` (UTF-8 YAML, `yaml.safe_load`).
- `validate(content: dict, static_dir: Path) -> list[str]`: every error as `"<yaml.path>: <message>"`, e.g. `"team[0].members[2].photo: file not found: img/team/x.webp"`. Empty list = valid.
- `REQUIRED: dict[str, list[str]]`: required keys per section, from spec 5.1 (`site`: title, url, description, contact_email; `hero`: title, subtitle, years, image, image_alt; each `years[]`: year, label, place, text, image, image_alt; `video`: youtube_id, title, thumbnail, thumbnail_alt; `csi`: name, logo, blurb; each team member: name, line, photo; each partner/sponsor: name, logo; each article: year, title, byline; each talk: year, venue, place, title).
- `FORBIDDEN: tuple[str, ...] = ("heart of europe", "2000 mw", "kinetic trigger", "extremophile")`.
- `filter_consented(content: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]`: returns a deep copy where team members, partners and sponsors without `consent is True` are removed, team groups left empty are removed, and the list of skipped names.
- `inline_md(text: str) -> markupsafe.Markup`: HTML-escape, then `*x*` -> `<em>x</em>`.
- `ImageInfo(NamedTuple): src: str, srcset: str, width: int, height: int` (`srcset` is `""` for single files).
- `image_info(static_dir: Path, ref: str) -> ImageInfo`: `ref` with an extension (`img/team/benassi.webp`) is a single file; `ref` without one (`img/p01-cover`) is a responsive set `img/p01-cover-{800,1400,2000}.webp` (whichever exist); `src` = largest, `srcset` = `"static/img/p01-cover-800.webp 800w, ..."`, width/height from the largest file via Pillow. Raises `FileNotFoundError` if nothing matches. All returned paths start with `static/`.

Image fields validated by `validate`: any key named `image`, `photo`, `logo`, `thumbnail`, `before`, `after` anywhere in the tree. Alt rule: a dict holding `image`/`thumbnail`/`before`/`after` must hold a non-empty `<key>_alt` (`image_alt`, `thumbnail_alt`, `before_alt`, `after_alt`); `photo` and `logo` use the entry's `name` as alt, so `name` must be non-empty.

### Task 3: `build.py` and templates

**Files:** Create `build.py`, `templates/base.html`, `templates/sections/{hero,project,years,watch,science,team,press,partners,contact}.html`, `tests/test_build.py`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: everything from Task 2.
- Produces: `build(root: Path, out: Path) -> int` (0 success, 1 validation error); `main()` calls `build(Path(__file__).parent, root/"_site")` and exits with its code. Jinja2 `Environment(autoescape=True, undefined=StrictUndefined)`; filters `md` = `inline_md`; global `img(ref) -> ImageInfo` bound to `static_dir`.

Behaviour of `build`: load -> validate (print each error to stderr, return 1, write nothing) -> `filter_consented` (print `"Skipped (no consent): A, B"` if any) -> render `base.html` -> delete `out` if it exists -> write `out/index.html` (UTF-8) -> copy `static/` to `out/static/` -> print `"Built <out>/index.html"`.

Markup decisions (implementer writes the HTML):
- `<html lang="en">`, `<meta charset="utf-8">`, viewport meta, `<title>` and `<meta name="description">` from `site`, Open Graph `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` (absolute `site.url` + hero image src; the only absolute URL allowed, because link previews need it, and it is in a `<meta>`, not `src`/`href`).
- Each section is `<section id="...">` with ids `top`, `project`, `years`, `watch`, `science`, `team`, `press`, `partners`, `contact`; nav links `#project #years #science #team #contact`.
- Every `<img>` has `alt`, `width`, `height`; `srcset`/`sizes` when `srcset` is non-empty; `loading="lazy"` on all except the hero, which gets `fetchpriority="high"`.
- Video: `<a class="video" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=913rFrz9-xo" data-youtube="913rFrz9-xo">` wrapping the thumbnail `<img>` and a play icon (inline SVG).
- Slider: `<figure class="compare">` with both images and `<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" aria-label="Compare 2006 and 2025" hidden>` (JS unhides it).
- Team section renders the `csi` block always and groups only if present.
- Footer: CSI logo, credits, `mailto:` contact, `© 2025-2027 CSI`.

### Task 4: `prepare_images.py`

**Files:** Create `prepare_images.py`, `tests/test_images.py`.

**Interfaces (Produces):**
- `WIDTHS = (800, 1400, 2000)`, `QUALITY = 78`.
- `responsive(src: Path, out_stem: Path) -> list[Path]`: writes `<out_stem>-<w>.webp` for each `w` in `WIDTHS` with `w <= src width`; if the source is narrower than 800, writes one file at its own width named `-<srcwidth>`. Applies EXIF orientation (`ImageOps.exif_transpose`).
- `square(src: Path, out: Path, size: int = 400) -> Path`: centre crop to square, resize, WebP.
- `logo(src: Path, out: Path, height: int) -> Path`: resize to `height` px (keep aspect, never upscale), keep transparency, save PNG optimised.
- `split_halves(src: Path, left_stem: Path, right_stem: Path) -> None`: crop left and right halves, each through `responsive`.
- `rasterise_pdf(src: Path, out_stem: Path) -> list[Path]`: `magick -density 200 <src>[0] <tmp.png>` via `subprocess.run(check=True)`, then `responsive`.
- `JOBS: list[tuple[str, str, str]]` at top of file, `(kind, source relative to BROCHURE, output relative to static/img)`; `main()` runs all jobs and prints each output and its size, then the total.

`JOBS` (outputs under `static/img/`):
- responsive: `figures/photos/p01-cover.jpg` -> `p01-cover`; `p06-lake.jpg` -> `p06-lake`; `p08-cauldron.jpg` -> `p08-cauldron`; `p08-sala-rosa.jpg` -> `p08-sala-rosa`; `figures/composites/f7_3d.jpg` -> `f7-3d`; `f7_ortho.jpg` -> `f7-ortho`; `f3_lake_overlay.jpg` -> `f3-lake-overlay`
- split: `figures/composites/f4_2006_vs_2025.jpg` -> `cmp-2006`, `cmp-2025` (implementer first opens the image to confirm it is two side-by-side halves; if it is labelled or bordered differently, stop and ask)
- pdf: `figures/composites/f2_iceland_map.pdf` -> `map-iceland`
- square: every file in `people/` -> `team/<surname>.webp` (map: benassi, bordin<-lorenzo, gerbaudo<-jerba, monticone<-lazzaro, trombini<-maria.png, ettrapini<-marco, urbanet, vicenzi<-paco, scialo, turrini, zampatti<-Katia, biondi<-tommi, testa; ignore `maria.jpeg`)
- logo (height 160): `logos/SSI.png`, `FVG.png`, `cai_logo.png`, `soc_geo_logo_crop.png`, `gaibana_logo.png`, `csi_logo_crop.png` -> `logos/<lowercase name>.png`
- thumbnail: download `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/913rFrz9-xo/maxresdefault.jpg` to a temp file with `urllib.request`, then `responsive` -> `video-thumb`

### Task 7: Motion (`script.js`)

**Files:** Create `static/script.js`. Modify `templates/base.html` (`<script src="static/script.js" defer>`), `static/style.css` (`.js` rules, reduced-motion block).

Behaviour per spec section 7: add `js` class to `<html>`; reveal on scroll (`.reveal` -> `.visible`, unobserve after); hero parallax at 0.3x via `requestAnimationFrame`, transform only, disabled when the hero is out of view; nav `aria-current="true"` for the section in view; slider: unhide range input, set `--pos` custom property driving `clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--pos)) 0 0)` on the top image; video: on click, `preventDefault`, replace the link with `<iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/913rFrz9-xo?autoplay=1" title="..." allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen>` sized 16:9. CSS: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` disables transitions, parallax and `scroll-behavior: smooth`.
